summary: CERTIFIED (computer): enumerated 162,539,696 K4 multigraphs with edge multiplicities 0..30 (hub edges sorted by vertex symmetry), including 2,858,722 with odd prime tree number below 20,000. Every one of the 2,261 odd primes has a non-square monodromy pairing; failure list is empty, including all 267 primes p≡1 mod 24. Independent exact determinant/cofactor/Legendre verification checks one stored witness per prime; thus no exhaustive unbounded-edge search is needed for this existence question.
not_done: No theorem for unbounded primes; p=2 excluded because quadratic nonresidue pairing is an odd-prime notion. Not a classification of all graphs.
next: Seek a uniform construction of these relaxed graph witnesses and isolate the cost of the fan restriction.

summary: PROVED/CERTIFIED: fixed gamma=[[tu−1,p],[t,tv−1]] from QUESTION_R Prop 1.1 and tested all 602 interior words at 44 primes p<500, p≡1 mod4 (43 nonempty fibres). Their mod-p images lie in the lower Borel but fill at most 2.565% of its single double coset; right multiplication by L has zero overlap modulo 4p, so no nonempty word set is a union of these Borel double cosets. The Fourier-conjugate delta-zero Weil coefficient on this Borel equals (A/p), and the exact character sums are tabulated; independent Gauss-ratio checks for p<100 agree within 1.12e−15. Thus character evaluation computes the original sign sum but supplies no double-coset orthogonality shortcut.
not_done: No exhaustive search over all subgroups and no construction of the full even-level Weil representation; the coefficient is obtained from its odd-p factor, inflated modulo 4p.
next: Any useful averaging must retain the thin word selection rather than saturating its Borel coset.

summary: PROVED: ES letters M(k)=[[k,−1],[1,0]] have determinant one, so no product is zero over Z or modulo any m>1. Reviewed the PCP-to-mortality reduction: it introduces a singular projector E11 to turn a zero entry into a zero matrix, a generator absent from ES. CERTIFIED: M(2),M(3) generate all SL2(F_p) for each of the 10 odd primes p≤31, so unrestricted modular-prefix pruning is vacuous; exhaustive length-three residues have p²−p+1 zero-(1,1)-entry targets and sign sum p(−1/p), agreeing exactly with the derived formulas. Modular zero entry is attainable, unlike mortality, and does not force the integer entry to equal p.
not_done: No bounded-height search speed benchmark; determinant invariant settles mortality for all lengths.
next: For actual pruning use remaining-length/height bounds, not zero-product invariants.

summary: PROVED: for the full ES HJ alphabet M(k), k≥2, T⁻¹M(k)T=R^(k−2)L; its closure is exactly positive L/R words ending in L, with Θ(N²) max-norm growth and critical exponent δ=1. CERTIFIED norm counts are 10,200,039 at N=4096 and 40,803,219 at 8192, giving δ_eff=1.000054152; the generated group is SL₂(Z), not thin. However the alphabet is infinite and the actual ES slice has exactly three HJ letters: its counts are only 80,592 and 197,523 at those bounds, so closure growth is not a local-global theorem for ES. The finite RS alphabet ⟨R,L⁴⟩ in QUESTION_R is a different semigroup, not the ES-letter closure.
not_done: No δ estimate for arbitrary alternative finite alphabets; no claimed RS theorem for the three-letter self-levelled slice.
next: Any orbit-counting transfer must control the three-letter extraction, not merely the fat semigroup closure.

summary: CERTIFIED: computed primitive indefinite forms [t,t(v−u),−p], exact minus-CF narrow-class cycles and prime-discriminant genus characters for all 308 words at the 29 primes p<300, p≡1 mod4. PROVED counterexample: gamma(13;2,2,5)=[[3,13],[2,9]] and gamma(17;2,3,4)=[[5,17],[2,7]]=R gamma(13) R⁻¹ share discriminant 140 and the same narrow class, but their signs are +1 and −1. There are 11 (D,genus)-cells with both signs, and 14 negative words in the principal genus; for p=89,(t,u,v)=(7,2,7), D=3717, all characters at −3,−7,−59 are +1 while (13/89)=−1. Thus even allowing a choice among genus characters for each discriminant cannot recover every word sign.
not_done: No complete class-group multiplication table is needed; classes are represented by exact canonical reduced cycles. Scope is the positive QUESTION_R gamma, not the different HJ product.
next: Any class-based sign encoding must retain a marked basis or level structure.

summary: CERTIFIED: verified Jun–Lee arXiv:1111.6717 §3 equation (9), whose q=1 specialization gives ζ(0,C)=Σ(b_i−3)/12 over a primitive minus-CF cycle. Extended all 308 word ideals for p<300, p≡1 mod4 to the maximal quadratic order by exact Hermite normal form before computing field narrow-class zeta values, avoiding the order/field discriminant confusion. Both unweighted proposals (one term per word, or one per distinct associated narrow class and field) disagree with the sign sum at all 28 nonempty prime fibres: at p=13 the values are 5/6 and 5/12 versus sign sum 0, and at p=17 they are 1/2 and 1/4 versus −2. Exact D=12 and D=5 calibration values are 1/12 and 0.
not_done: No exclusion of arbitrary weighted or marked-class identities; no such weights are specified in the item.
next: A viable zeta identity would need explicit marked-class weights, not an unweighted sum of class invariants.

summary: CERTIFIED: implemented Ibukiyama’s basis 1,(1+β)/2,α(1+β)/2,(r+α)β/q (α²=−p,β²=−q), checking multiplication closure and reduced discriminant p for all 969 admissible (p,q), 3≤p<200 and q<1000. Exact norm-shell and uv+vu=1 searches test all 720 distinct certificate-induced Λ_(d,ab), giving 2,083 embeddings in 14,937 order-target tests and covering 387 targets at 44/45 primes; each successful inclusion has independently checked lattice index e. Least Type-I level is preserved at 39 primes, increases at 73:3→23, 97:7→15, 113:3→7, 131:1→5, 179:1→5, and no tested O(q,r) hosts any of the four targets at p=193. The fixed small-q orders therefore genuinely filter certificates rather than automatically realizing every genus-admissible target.
not_done: No claim that q<1000 exhausts order isomorphism classes; O-prime(q,r) and maximal orders outside Ibukiyama’s sqrt(−p)-containing family are not tested. p=2 excluded.
next: Check whether p=193 remains excluded after exhausting the sqrt(−p)-containing order classes, rather than merely increasing q.

summary: CERTIFIED: enumerated all 12,819 primitive reduced classes (1,779 ambiguous) at the 484 levels 2≤t≤12 and p<500, p≡1 mod4, and evaluated prime-discriminant genus characters. Of 231 unordered word factorizations, 155 give primitive ambiguous forms [A,0,A*], while 76 are imprimitive and belong after division by content g to discriminant −4(tp+1)/g², not the claimed class group. Words occupy multiple genera at 17 levels and share a genus with nonword ambiguous classes in 66 cells; for example p=37,t=7 gives word [13,0,20] and nonword [5,0,52] in genus (−1,−1,+1). More decisively at p=457,t=2, word forms [3,0,305] and [5,0,183] have the same full genus signature (−1,−1,+1) for (−3,5,61), but ES signs +1 and −1.
not_done: No complete multiplication tables or unbounded-p classification; primitive reduced forms and genus signatures suffice for the stated counterexamples.
next: Retain divisor residues and form content; the word condition and sign are not determined by the genus of discriminant −4(tp+1).

summary: PROVED symbolically: with M(k)=[[k,−1],[1,0]], tr(M(v)M(t)M(u))=p−t and pair-letter traces are vt−2,tu−2,uv−2; the full four-holed-sphere Fricke cubic is verified exactly. For two words at the same p, tr(GH)=p²+ts−A B*−A* B and tr(GH⁻¹)=A B*+A* B−p(t+s), with the commutator trace identity also checked. CERTIFIED: all 350 interior words and 1,723 same-p word pairs at odd primes p<200 give 20,396 specified trace assignments; 9,636 have positive formal residual D=ABC−pA²−B², but none satisfy the essential MARKOFF_ES condition 2D|C. Without that condition the proposed relation merely defines D; this direct trace search produces no certificate-level identification.
not_done: No search over arbitrary affine transformations of trace coordinates or pairs with different target primes; no claim that all alternative trace encodings are excluded.
next: A non-tautological trace reformulation must specify D independently and preserve the level divisibility.
